recording.observation: At about 0.75 seconds the selected Private group switches to All behind search; return shows All around 1.75 seconds before restoring Private around 2 seconds.

cause: CSGroupListAdapter refresh preserved the active group during search only when privacy was inactive; active privacy forced preset_0 and republished its rows and tab selection.
fix: Preserve the selected group while search owns its independent page, rebuild the same group on privacy changes, and retain explicit global result navigation. Clear retained search chrome on account changes.

tests.implementation_under_test: Extracted production refresh/header/search hooks plus real CSGroupProjection; native source and UIKit fixture only.
tests.additional_final_check: Account change discards retained backing header.

limitations: Host replay does not establish physical-device frame rendering.
No device installation, native search query, or live-message operation was performed.
